title: AquaTerra in May 2026: {count} drives, cards and Smile Notes
description: May 2026 at AquaTerra: {count} drives, Mother's Day cards at Disha Foundation, Smile Notes at Lake Town and Bangur, and a digital safety workshop.
lede: In May 2026 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, between 9 and 16 May. The month was lighter than April: Mother's Day cards at Disha Foundation, three Smile Notes stops on the street at Lake Town Footbridge and at Bangur, and a digital safety workshop at Pather Sathi to finish.

sections.heading: cards for mothers
body: On 9 May students made Mother's Day cards at Disha Foundation, and the session produced 16 cards. It was the month's only craft session, and the cards were the thing the children made. Disha Foundation also hosted the April grammar work, so the team returns to a room it already knows.

sections.heading: smile notes, on the footbridge and at bangur
body: [Smile Notes](/impact/smile-notes) ran three times in May. On 10 May and again on 15 May it stopped at Lake Town Footbridge, and on 15 May it also stopped at Bangur. Each stop handed out notes with affirmations, with a toffee given alongside each note, the same format the team used in March.
Lake Town Footbridge hosted two of the three stops, so it is the place to look at if you want to see the format twice.

sections.heading: digital safety, to close the month
body: The last drive of the month was the Digital Safety Workshop at Pather Sathi on 16 May. Student volunteers taught children essential digital safety in an interactive session. [Pather Sathi](/impact/pather-sathi) is where many of AquaTerra's workshops take place, and this one fits that pattern.

sections.heading: may after april
body: [April 2026](/impact/month-2026-04) had {count:month-2026-04} drives, and May had {count} of them, with fewer classroom sessions and more time on the street. The spring is easiest to read as a sequence: the grammar in April, then the cards, the Smile Notes stops and a safety session in May.

learnings: A short month still tells a story. One format, Smile Notes, carried three stops in a single week.
Craft days such as Mother's Day cards need only one host and one room, so they can sit between heavier months of street work.
Pick a host you know. Disha Foundation hosted an April grammar session and the May card-making, so the team returned to a familiar room.

faqs.q: What did AquaTerra do in May 2026?
faqs.a: In May 2026 AquaTerra ran {count} drives with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts. The month had Mother's Day cards at Disha Foundation, three Smile Notes stops at Lake Town Footbridge and Bangur, and a digital safety workshop at Pather Sathi on 16 May.

faqs.q: Where were AquaTerra's Smile Notes stops in May 2026?
faqs.a: Smile Notes stopped at Lake Town Footbridge on 10 and 15 May 2026, and at Bangur on 15 May. Each stop handed out notes with affirmations, and a toffee came with each one.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra run a digital safety workshop?
faqs.a: Yes. On 16 May 2026 the Digital Safety Workshop at Pather Sathi taught children essential digital safety through an interactive session led by AquaTerra student volunteers.

faqs.q: How can I join AquaTerra's next drive?
faqs.a: Sign in to AquaTerra with Google and wait for approval. Students who join take part in drives like these across Kolkata.
